Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by geopolitical tensions and Meta's AI spending woes. This directly impacts your tech and chip-heavy book.

Your holdings: SMCI (-24.37%), MUU (-37.32%), and SOXL (-62.82%) are deep in the red and flagged for attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader tech sentiment, especially around AI spending and semiconductor demand.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your significant losses in leveraged names and protecting your capital.
plays: Trim SMCI: If it breaks below your stop of $37.3, consider cutting losses to preserve capital.
Trim MUU: Similar to SMCI, if MUU breaks its stop at $31.6, consider trimming.
Trim SOXL: This is your biggest loser. If it shows any weakness near your stop (which is very wide at $200), consider reducing exposure.
